name: io.github.infotik/orano-mcp-server
description: Personal, read-only MCP server that exposes the user's ORANO library (projects, tasks, research, roadmaps, memory facts) as tools for their own AI agent.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's ORANO projects with optional status filters (active, completed, skipped, archived).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return a single project's full structured understanding including summary, key points, ordered tasks, resources, research, and learning roadmap.

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Return only the requested context fields (summary, overview, caption, transcript, visual_context, links, tasks, roadmap, source, raw_source) in structured, Markdown, or text output.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the user's projects by title, summary, source title, or URL.

tools.name: read_memory_facts
tools.description: Return curated memory facts with confidence and freshness signals, optionally filtered by kind.

tools.name: get_pending_handoffs
tools.description: Retrieve acknowledged-once projects explicitly sent from the ORANO app to a target agent.

metadata.status: Live on iOS App Store, pre-revenue
